title: Enchi's Netherrack
description: A netherrack retexture based on it's look prior 1.14.
body:
The textures introduced in 1.14 are amazing; so is the new netherrack texture. But I feel like the appeal of the old netherrack was lost despite the improvements to it.

This resource pack attempts to bring back what made the old netherrack so special for some of us, with a look that tries to mesh well with modern Minecraft and its updtated textures.

![A comparison of the netherrack blocks with and without the resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a03df014eaeab8e7f31bb2902f13e562a11b3d47.png)

Want a better look? Check out the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enchis-netherrack/settings/gallery) for more!
